notes: Card: '0' x4 of '0.2 dB', ' MySQL' x2, 'avorites' of favoritesdb, 'DEV' of DEV_DATABASE_URL. Probe: 0.2 dB '0' 0.58, favoritesdb 0.49, DEV 0.33; 0.2 kg 0.00, open(favorites) 0.06, 'HOME' 0.01, 'uses MySQL' 0.04. Note the logit direction: the + pole promotes ' database', ' db', so the - pole suppresses them. So this is not a claim that the pole predicts db; I do not know why it fires here.
